map.按 0-4 级评定直接对光反射，并选择 RAPD(摆动光照试验)分级，辅助传入/: Grade direct light reflex on a 0-4 scale and choose RAPD (swinging-flashlight test) grading, aiding afferent/efferent lesion localization.
map.📖 查看「瞳孔(对光反射)反应分级器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Pupil (Light Reflex) Response Grader User Guide"
map.瞳孔光反射：直接反射按 0–3 分级（3 正常、2 减弱、1 迟钝、0 无反应）: Pupil light reflex: direct reflex graded 0-3 (3 normal, 2 reduced, 1 sluggish, 0 no response); RAPD positive suggests afferent weakness (retina/optic nerve) on the weak side; bilateral reduction suggests oculomotor efferent lesion; interpret with inter-eye symmetry.
map.RAPD(相对性传入瞳孔障碍，摆动光照): RAPD (relative afferent pupillary defect, swinging light)
map.3+ 无收缩直接扩大 / 4+ 固定散大: 3+ No constriction, direct dilation / 4+ Fixed dilated
map.直接反射=光照该眼的反应；间接反射=光照对侧眼时该眼反应。RAPD 阳性提示该侧: Direct reflex = response of the illuminated eye; consensual = response of the fellow eye when the other is illuminated. RAPD positive suggests afferent lesion of that retina/optic nerve.
map.⚠️ 瞳孔检查需在暗光下进行，注意生理性瞳孔不等大(差异<0.4mm且反射正常): ⚠️ Pupil exam needs dim light; note physiologic anisocoria (difference <0.4 mm with normal reflex). Results are for teaching only.
map.对直接对光反射与 RAPD 进行分级，辅助视神经传入障碍与动眼神经传出障碍定位。: Grades direct light reflex and RAPD, aiding optic-nerve afferent and oculomotor efferent lesion localization.
map.📚 深度解析：瞳孔对光反射与 RAPD 评估: 📚 Deep Dive: Pupil Light Reflex and RAPD Assessment
map.视神经与视路病变筛查。: Optic nerve and visual pathway lesion screening.
map.右眼直接反应减弱（2<3），RAPD 阳性定侧右眼（OD<OS），提示右眼视神经: Right direct response reduced (2<3), RAPD positive localizes to right eye (OD<OS), suggests right optic-nerve afferent damage.
map.双侧正常、无 RAPD，瞳孔通路完整。: Both normal, no RAPD, pupil pathway intact.
map.交替光照双眼，患侧眼由暗转亮时仍散大（相对），即阳性。: Alternately illuminate both eyes; the affected eye still dilates (relative) when going from dark to light, i.e. positive.
map.视神经炎、显著视神经压迫、视网膜病变等单侧传入损害。: Optic neuritis, significant optic-nerve compression, retinopathy and other unilateral afferent lesions.
map.瞳孔对光反射反应分级器：对直接/间接对光反射与RAPD(相对性传入瞳孔障碍)进行: Pupil light reflex response grader: grades direct/consensual light reflex and RAPD (relative afferent pupillary defect), aiding pupil-abnormality localization. A medical professional tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
